newsitem.title: USA: US consumer confidence 107.3 in Nov vs rvsd 107.3.
newsitem.headline: US consumer confidence 107.3 in Nov vs rvsd 107.3.

text.p: The index of U.S. consumer confidence held steady at 107.3 in November, unchanged from a revised reading of 107.3 in October, the Conference Board said on Tuesday.
The expectations component of the November index fell to 91.4 from a revised 95.7, and the present situation component rose to 131.0 from a revised 124.6.

"This strong level of confidence, coupled with low unemployment, modest inflationary pressures and continuing wage growth, should translate into healthy holiday sales in coming weeks," according to a report by the Conference Board.
The Conference Board said that "consumers are more positive about current business conditions that at any time this decade."
